entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Yeah, I need to make a return.
Hi there, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I...
Look, Diana, I'm short on time. I bought some cycling shoes and I need to return them. Is that possible, yes or no?
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I'm sending you down the right path, is it a technical fault with the shoe or a preference issue?
They don't work for me. They're causing terrible blisters right near where the cleats mount. The fit is just wrong. I want a refund.

I'm sorry to hear they're causing blisters. Let me just pull up your account. I see the order for the cycling shoes here... it looks like they were delivered about 32 days ago. One moment while I check the policy for you.
Alright, I've confirmed it. Since these are a standard item, they fall under our 90-day return window. You're well within that timeframe, so yes, we can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Great. Finally. So what's the next step?

I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. And since you're a VIP member with us, I've gone ahead and waived the standard restocking fee. Just box them up, attach the label, and you can drop them off with the courier. You'll see the refund processed 3 to 5 business days after we receive them.
Got the email. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
